theory.intro: Reflect the graph of a one-to-one function in $y=x$.
facts: Reflect endpoints and asymptotes as well as ordinary points.
Keep open endpoints open and closed endpoints closed.
Use only the selected one-to-one branch.

foundation.question_text:
The table gives values of a one-to-one function.
$\begin{array}{c|ccc}x&0&1&2\\f(x)&1&3&5\end{array}$
Complete the inverse table.
What is $f^{-1}(5)$?

The table gives values of a one-to-one function.
$\begin{array}{c|ccc}x&0&1&2\\f(x)&2&4&6\end{array}$
Complete the inverse table.
What is $f^{-1}(6)$?

A curve has asymptotes $x=5$ and $y=7$.
State the asymptotes after reflection in $y=x$.
foundation.solution_text:
Vertical and horizontal lines exchange roles.
$x=7,\ y=5$
